title: A Signal for the Echo
author: K. M. Zhou
blurb: Dominic Quintana, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
